row.notes: Builds the extra-world descriptor of a track layer row: rcx the descriptor, rdx the track (FILENAME token from [rdx+0x78], 0x142e57efb), r8 the TrackLayer row (Game_Read_TrackLayerRow). It expands the row's worldAssetGroup (+0x18) and worldEri (+0x20) values with 0x140234f30, so the world archive of a layer is '[FILENAME]'-templated database data, and names the world extraWorld_track_layer_%u (0x1457ed34d) from the row's u8 statId (movzx at 0x142e585a0), not from its row index: two layer rows with one statId name their worlds alike. Only caller Game_GameMode_AddTrackLayerWorlds 0x1407a13c9, once per matching row each time a session's settings are built, so a layer row change takes effect at the next session's settings build. Steam 1.0.145 (sigport --witness): 0x142e5a420 530/530 with +0xc, +0x18, +0x20 and +0x78 at the same instructions. | re-bindings 2026-11-18: the arguments, the statId width and the 1.0.145 witness.
